# Ancient Indian Botanicals

Ancient Indian Botanicals is an incorporated Indian B2B botanical sourcing company based in Mandsaur, Madhya Pradesh.

## Product scope

- Botanical ingredients: whole, cut, powdered and selected extract grades
- Natural essential oils
- Aroma oils and fragrance accords, clearly identified separately from natural essential oils
- Carrier oils
- Hydrosols, floral waters and clays
- Seeds, nuts, makhana, coconut products, jaggery, millets and dehydrated food ingredients
- Cold-pressed and culinary oil routes, with intended grade confirmed per enquiry
- Sample, bulk and selected private-label packaging routes subject to confirmation

The website catalogue contains 122 products across botanicals, aromatic ingredients, seeds, nuts, value-added food ingredients and cold-pressed oils. Availability, origin, composition, analytical specification, documentation, MOQ, pricing, packaging and lead time are confirmed only for the specific offered supplier lot and approved enquiry.

## Commercial process

Buyer requirement review, suitable supply-route identification, lot-document review, packaging confirmation, written quotation and export coordination.

## Important notices

Ancient Indian Botanicals is incorporated in India. Website content is for B2B commercial evaluation and is not medical advice. The website does not claim universal organic certification, regulatory approval, laboratory testing or fixed dispatch timelines.
